source: Codex app-server protocol messages copied unchanged (LF line endings, as the upstream repository stores them) from ben-vargas/ai-sdk-provider-codex-cli at 88eaa5c58d511bb4c7e7e4f6daf735da72018d1f (bv@88eaa5c), src/__tests__/fixtures/app-server-protocol/{server-requests,notifications}/*.json, renamed server-request-<name>.json and notification-<name>.json (15 §4.4 Fixtures needed). The two upstream files ending in -with-extra.json (auth-refresh, turn-completed) are upstream's own; every other -with-extra.json adds dwarfaiUnknownField to every object, as scripts/fixtures/scrub.mjs does (HR T1). The *-codex-0153 messages are upstream's captures of Codex 0.153; the others are upstream's hand-written shapes. They are reference data for the CodexAppServerDriver's protocol readers, not a replayed session.
